summary: New Oriental Education & Technology Group Inc. filed a Form 6-K on July 29, 2026, attaching a press release announcing its unaudited financial results for the fourth fiscal quarter and fiscal year ended May 31, 2026. The filing reports year-over-year increases in net revenues (23.0% to $1,529.5 million), operating income ($85.8 million vs. a loss), and net income (775.8% to $62.2 million). There are no transactional elements or special-situation events. This is a routine earnings release reported as a foreign private issuer under Rule 13a-16, analogous to a U.S. Form 8-K Item 2.02. No deal terms, board recommendations, or activist activity are present. What to watch: none; this is a standard periodic financial update.
